name: Guimbal Cabri G2
summary: A French two-seat piston light helicopter used heavily for flight training, with a three-blade rotor and a small ducted tail fan.

wings: Three-blade main rotor, short and stubby
Rotor head set low on a short mast with a smooth fairing
engines: Single piston engine behind the cabin under a smooth cowl
No exhaust stack on the roof
fuselage: Rounded two-seat egg-shaped cabin with a big glazed bubble
Skids on short struts; one door each side
tail: Small ducted fan tail set in the base of the fin
Stubby tail boom with an X- or V-shaped tail stabilizer around the fan

tellTales: Small two-seat egg of a helicopter with a ducted tail fan
Three-blade rotor on a short stubby mast
Tiny size and rounded nose, with a piston engine and no roof exhaust

confusedWith.howToTell: The R22 has a two-blade rotor and an open exposed tail rotor on a thin boom; the Cabri has three blades and a tail fan inside the fin.
The EC120 is larger with five seats, a single turbine exhaust and a bigger fenestron; the Cabri is a tiny two-seater with a piston engine.
The R44 has four seats, a two-blade rotor and an exposed tail rotor; the Cabri is smaller and has a ducted tail fan.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
